notes.title: Update Game Engine Version
notes.content:
Game Engine: Godot 4.4 => Godot 4.5

Added auxiliary lines to make it easier to distinguish the line being operated.

notes.title: Update Setting UI
notes.content: [p]When changing settings with a controller (or keyboard), the currently selected item will now be displayed with a yellow border.[/p][p]Also, if there are items that cannot be changed due to other settings, the selection of those items will be skipped.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45297801/bcf247c843d2d852d39bb18c808c7880efe5a543.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Fixed block operation end judgment
notes.content:
Fixed block operation end judgment.
If block operation can not move for left or right, the block operation will be end.
This fixes a bug where sound effects would play without moving blocks.

Improved display when ranking information can not received.

notes.title: Changed the layout of the title screen
notes.content:
Changed the layout of the title screen.
Added images and How To Play.

notes.title: change the draw order of objects
notes.content:
Changed the z-order of object.
Animation effect go to background of pazzle symbole.

notes.title: Graphics Update
notes.content:
The animation at the bottom of the screen has been changed from white line drawing to color.

notes.title: Revision of combo bonus
notes.content:
Changed the formula for calculating bonus scores for combos.
Larger chains will allow you to earn larger bonuses.

There are few combo bonuses that can be easily created.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45297801/547069255bd222d5e4618ab67ed5094089575bca.png[/img]

The larger the combo, the greater the score multiplier.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45297801/1b58a3efff7864b04e6c5948a0f009b84775cdb3.png[/img]

notes.title: bugfix: bonus notifications
notes.content: Fixed a bug where bonus notifications were not brought to the top order.

notes.title: Update: Screen layout
notes.content:
The screen layout has been revised and the animation area has been split into left and right.
Also, the bonus display has been updated to make it easier to see that the score is boosted by the bonus.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45297801/11637a4c8c6fd1e7f7a35ccc4a067f94694be556.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45297801/25b4f173c07bd56d512bd687091ecddd46e5cb65.png[/img][/url]

The displayed message and score will change depending on the chain state.

notes.title: Resource Management Update
notes.content: To prevent delays in rendering updates, some resources are now loaded in the background.
